kind: Manual upstream release/security/migration review; no live-service acceptance

components.name: AWS SDK
components.status: Newer release exists; no advisory newer than the pin. The Base64 advisories CVE-2026-19642/19643 were fixed in 1.11.862, before this pin. No action before stable.

components.name: Qt AppImage
components.status: Current. Embedded HarfBuzz 14.5.0 carries CVE-2026-113679; the scoped exception recorded under #1055 (PR #1065) keys on the libQt6Gui fingerprint and the absent WASM shaper and expires 2027-01-29 (#1070). No newer Qt bundles HarfBuzz 15 yet.

components.name: FFmpeg
components.status: Unchanged since the 2026-10-31 review. Exact source/configuration/library scopes match the existing policy dispositions (expire 2027-01-21); raw findings retained. No new exception.

components.name: Bun (embedded Proton helper runtime)
components.status: Current. The three High advisories that blocked 3384 (#1054) are all patched in 1.4.4 and the helper was relinked in #1071: GHSA-663w-cv8g-jj2p / CVE-2026-111497 Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write (affects >=1.0.21, <1.4.4); GHSA-26q8-h657-pf84 compromised eMudhra (emSign) intermediate CA trust (affects <1.4.4); GHSA-cf8x-9m69-3gg3 HTTP/3 QPACK amplification (affects >=1.3.14, <1.4.4; HTTP/3 is off by default and unused by the helper). Published 2026-10-23/24; no advisory newer than 2026-10-24 is published.

components.name: Proton Drive SDK (@protontech/drive-sdk)
components.status: Current; upgraded from 0.22.2 in b8894b94f after the 2026-10-31 review. The 0.22.2..0.23.0 range (20 monorepo commits) marks two client breaking changes (node type required for available-name lookup; experimental search methods) and adds album capabilities; the helper is built against 0.23.0 and the Live Proton cell is green on all five desktops for this nightly (#1003). README still targets the cryptographic migration for end of 2026/early 2027 with final timing pending; older SDK releases will stop interoperating once the service switches.

components.name: Proton helper npm inputs
components.status: Major updates deferred; no advisory. #369's direct web-stream-tools pin is present.

liveCompatibilityEvidence.scope: Nightly Tier 1 'Live Proton' cell (region capture uploaded to the Proton test account, link checked) on v26.1101.3698-nightly, all five desktops green
liveCompatibilityEvidence.notCovered: Browser authentication and refresh, anonymous protected/unprotected download equality, sharing history, interruption/reconciliation and old journal/config/receipt compatibility were not rerun for this review.

nextAction: None before stable. Rerun this review on the exact stable draft under #384; revisit #1070 when a Qt release bundles HarfBuzz 15; FFmpeg/ICU dispositions expire 2027-01-21.
